you say what you mean, fast. send the message, but read it once before you hit send.
you get serious about money. ask for the rate you deserve, cancel what you don't use.
mars in your sign: more drive, less patience. start the big thing, just don't pick every fight.
quieter energy for you. work behind the scenes and protect your sleep.
group projects heat up. you'll see who actually pulls their weight.
ambition switches on. people notice what you're doing, so do it on purpose.
you're restless for something new: a course, a trip, a big idea. pick one and commit.
intense feelings and honest money talks. deal with the thing you keep avoiding.
relationships get direct. someone pushes you, or you finally push back. both can be healthy.
